title: Reliability Radar: Adaptive SLI Cohorting, Initiative Tags, and Error Budget Reallocation
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Build an 'Reliability Radar' capability in the Initiative Hub that automatically groups services/feature work into SLI cohorts, surfaces initiative-level error budget burn, and proposes reallocation recommendations. This ticket scopes the PM work: acceptance criteria, UX flows, guardrails for automated recommendations, and integration points with metrics/telemetry/alerts. The goal is to reduce manual coordination when error budgets are exhausted and enable faster, auditable decisions for initiative prioritization and mitigations.
acceptance_criteria: Initiative Hub shows SLI cohort assignment for every tracked initiative with a confidence score and last-evaluated timestamp.
Error budget burn visualization available per cohort and per initiative for configurable windows (1h, 24h, 30d).
Automatic recommendation engine suggests one of: throttle, rollback, pause non-essential experiments, or reallocate error budget from low-risk initiatives, with rationale and confidence level.
Recommendations are annotated with required approvers and a clear audit trail (who/when/why) and can be applied or dismissed by owners.
Integration tests demonstrate recommendation creation when burn rate exceeds threshold and that no recommendation is auto-applied without manual approval unless governance flag enabled.
Dashboard links, design spec, and a developer acceptance checklist are included in the PR and reviewed by reliability engineering and security.
No-user-facing downtime is introduced; experiments run in staging before rollout to production cohorts.
decisions: We will start with latency and availability SLIs only; error-rate SLI variants to follow in phase 2.
Cohorting algorithm will combine service ownership tags, shared infra dependencies, and historical SLI correlation rather than relying solely on product area metadata.
Recommendations will be 'advisory' by default and require at least one approver; automatic enforcement gated behind an enterprise opt-in setting.
Use existing telemetry (Prometheus + tracing) as the canonical SLI source; introduce a lightweight SLI-mapping layer in the console to resolve derivations.
Store audit events in the existing event-log stream to leverage retention and export policies for compliance.
tradeoffs: Automated reallocation could reduce response time but increases risk of mis-prioritization — mitigated by confidence scoring and human approval gates.
Starting with a small set of SLIs reduces surface area but delays full coverage for complex failure modes.
Cohorting by correlation improves signal but adds compute/analysis cost; initial run cadence will be hourly to limit compute and avoid noise.
tech_deps: Metrics ingestion pipeline: need a small schema extension to tag time series with initiative_id and cohort_id.
Console: new Initiative Hub card UI and recommendation modal; design spec in Drive.
Authz: approver flows must honor RBAC groups from SSO/SAML identity sync.
Event logging: audit events must be written to event-log; infra ticket ENG-38210 assigned for retention configuration.
notes: PM kickoff 2025-02-12: agreed to phased approach, scope MVP to hosted production tenants and Dedicated pilot customers.
Priority customers flagged: AcmeHealth and PayCloud — both require audit trail and approval workflows before any automatic actions.
We should avoid using 'auto-heal' phrasing in UX to prevent expectations of guaranteed recovery; prefer 'recommendation' or 'action suggestion'.
We will include a 'what-if' simulator in the Initiative Hub to allow product owners to preview impact of reallocating a tranche of error budget.
Localization: ensure labels and messages are translation-safe for EU customers.
